haiku.problem: The explanation leans on an earlier card: "It matches the seedlings with no root in the sun" depends on the seedlings card (1-9), so it doesn't stand on its own.
"Remember the thorns that grew up and choked the seedlings (Matthew 13:7), friends?" relies on the earlier thorns card (1-11), which the rules forbid. The explanation must stand on its own.
"Back on the path, the one who heard did not understand it" refers to the earlier path card (3-2), so it doesn't stand on its own.
